title: complete survives a slow control plane instead of failing at 120 s
description: Runs the real CLI against a control-plane stub whose idempotency receipts work like the plane's own. When the stub answers the first submit only after the CLI's 120 s request bound and the retry promptly, complete succeeds with the head submitted exactly once under one idempotency key and names the retry; when the stub applied the first request before the bound, the retry is answered from the receipt and reports the submission as already recorded, still exactly once, exiting 0.

steps.name: Complete retries a submission a slow control plane did not answer, under one idempotency key
